# Mobile Readiness

<!-- GENERATED by tools/generate-docs.mts — run `pnpm docs:generate`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Purpose: guarantee that when the iOS/Android app is built, **nothing important lives
only in the web app**. The API is the product core; the web is one client.

**Mobile readiness: 100%** of SHARED features.

## Definition of "Mobile Ready"

1. Business logic exists server-side · 2. API endpoint exists · 3. API documented ·
4. Auth works through the API · 5. Permissions enforced server-side ·
6. Request/response contracts stable · 7. Media represented independently of web UI ·
8. Filtering/pagination server-side · 9. API tests exist · 10. No web-only server behavior.

Total documented endpoints: 177.
